description: Design notes: (1) An 'offer' is dispensary-specific; cross-store comparison joins offers on canonical_product_id. (2) Verbatim source fields (source_name, source_description) are stored unaltered alongside normalized fields — this preserves provenance and is the control point for the open Ohio legal question about third-party alteration of dispensary content. (3) THC is split into thc_percent and thc_mg_total/thc_mg_per_serving and the two must never be merged or converted into each other. (4) Prices are menu list prices before tax; discounts carry eligibility so a veteran-only price is never shown as the general price.

customer_segment.description: Some menus/SKUs are medical-only or priced per segment.

quantity.description: Only when the source states it (e.g. Jane 'Only 1 left'). Never estimate.

canonical_product.description: The standardized product identity shared across dispensaries. Two offers are 'the same product' only if brand_normalized, product_name_normalized, category, form, and package weight all match.

brand_normalized.description: Canonical brand from BudScout's brand alias table (e.g. 'Pure Ohio Wellness'). Raw brand string kept in source_listing.

form.description: Sub-form, e.g. 'whole flower', 'ground flower', 'cartridge', 'gummy', 'live resin'. Free text in v1; controlled vocabulary later.

potency_basis.description: Menus display label claims; Ohio flower THC varies by batch. Record the basis, never present as lab-verified by BudScout.

thc_mg_total.description: Total THC mg per package — edibles, beverages, tinctures.

thc_percent.description: THC % by weight — flower, vapes, concentrates. Never populate from a mg value.

product_name_normalized.description: Normalized name with weight/units stripped (weight lives in package). Registered product name is preserved verbatim in source_listing.source_name.

name.description: Cultivar name as listed (e.g. 'Jokerz'). Do NOT republish effect descriptors ('relaxing', 'uplifted') as strain attributes — Ohio treats effect words as health/therapeutic claims (see report §5).

dispensary.description: Join key to the BudScout Ohio dispensary dataset (~/workspace/budscout-ohio-dispensaries).

license_id.description: Ohio DCC license ID, e.g. CCD000065-00. Primary key; strip whitespace when matching.

menu_url.description: Click-through target: the dispensary's own menu (never a BudScout checkout).

retrieved_at.description: When BudScout last pulled this offer. Displayed to users as 'price checked …'.

source_updated_at.description: Provider's own updated timestamp when supplied.

stale_after.description: Policy: hide or badge the price once past this time (recommended: retrieved_at + 24h for price display; sooner for availability).

offer_id.description: BudScout internal ID, e.g. 'off_' + hash(dispensary license_id + source provider + source SKU). Stable across refreshes.

count.description: Units in package where relevant (e.g. 2 pre-rolls, 10 gummies). Part of product identity: a 2-pack is not the same product as a 1-pack.

weight_display_source.description: Weight exactly as the source displayed it, e.g. '1/8 oz' or '14.15g'.

weight_g.description: Canonical net weight in grams. Ohio flower units are gram-based: 2.83 g (= 1/10 oz), 5.66 g, 14.15 g, 28.3 g. Convert fractional-ounce displays to these gram values; keep the source display string in source_listing.

eligibility.description: Ohio discount rules (OAC 1301:18-8-11 + DCC discount guidance) impose tier parity; eligibility must travel with the price so comparisons stay honest.

effective_price.description: Price a general customer pays now: sale price if a discount applies to everyone, otherwise list_price. Restricted-eligibility discounts (veteran, indigent, first-time, loyalty) must NOT lower effective_price; record them under discount with eligibility set. Null when no usable price was displayed (e.g. out of stock) - never 0, never invented.

list_price.description: Regular menu price for this variant, before tax. Null when no usable price was displayed (e.g. out of stock) - never 0, never invented.

price_per_gram.description: effective_price / weight_g, computed only when category is flower AND form is comparable (never compare whole flower $/g to ground/shake $/g, never across categories, never for edibles/vapes — use $/100mg THC there if anything, labeled as such). Null when not meaningful.

tax_included.description: Menu prices are pre-tax. UI must say so; tax treatment differs for medical patients vs adult-use consumers.

authorization_basis.description: There is no 'public webpage' value: visible != licensed. Offers with basis 'none' must not be published.

raw_payload_ref.description: Pointer/hash of the stored raw response for audit and diffing.

source_listing.description: The listing exactly as the source published it — the audit and compliance layer.

source_description.description: Verbatim description. Must pass the effect/health-claim screen before any public display (see report §5).

source_sku_id.description: Provider's own product/variant ID at this store, when the authorized feed exposes one.

title: BudScout Offer — one dispensary's listing of one product variant, normalized for price comparison
